title: EEGLAB
body_html:
EEGLAB is an open-source MATLAB environment for processing continuous and event-related EEG, MEG, and related electrophysiological data. It combines an interactive graphical interface with an extensive scripting and plugin ecosystem.

  • Independent component analysis and artifact modeling
  • Time/frequency analysis and event-related dynamics
  • Source localization, connectivity, and visualization
  • Community plugins for reproducible EEG workflows
Visit EEGLAB ↗

title: NEMAR
body_html:
NEMAR connects BIDS-formatted EEG, MEG, and iEEG datasets with OpenNeuro, quality visualization, and high-performance computing through SDSC and NSG.

  • Browse and search openly shared EEG/MEG/iEEG datasets
  • Validate metadata and inspect dataset quality
  • Run large-scale analyses on shared compute infrastructure
